title: Context health
hint: How big your context runs and where you compact. Smaller context means cheaper calls.

cards.name: Context per call
cards.sub: How big your context runs each day. Try to stay between 250k and 450k.

cards.name: Where you compact
cards.sub: Each dot is one compaction, at the context size where it happened. Try to compact near the optimum line.

cards.name: What a call costs
cards.sub: Average price of one model call at each context size. Compact earlier and calls get cheaper.

cards.name: Spent on oversized context
cards.sub: Money spent carrying context above the 450k line. Compact earlier to bring it down.

cards.name: Subagent context
cards.sub: Median context per subagent type. A fork inherits the whole conversation; Explore starts small.

cards.name: Steps per prompt
cards.sub: How many model calls your agents take per task, and the long tail.
